description: Fork of exp211 (E=192, V2D hard, val_bpb=1.7909 @ 8K, 59M). Single change: replace single-Linear unembedder head with a 2-layer MLP: ln_f -> Linear(E, 4*E) -> GELU -> Linear(4*E, VOCAB), no bias. Adds ~19M params (head 6.29M -> 25.3M). Hypothesis: at small E the linear unembedder is rank-bounded by E=192; an MLP head with hidden=768 lets the unembedder learn nonlinear token-class boundaries.
